module: Global filter (runningOrder 0.5) that applies TrackIR head tracking: shifts the position (nx, ny, nz * 0.00005) and rotates the camera (yaw, pitch, roll * 0.01 degree). Initializes via TrackIR.init()/start(); without TrackIR available, it does nothing. Disabled during an OpenXR session. Returns a constructor.

C.desc: TrackIR filter. Field working: true if TrackIR could start.

init.desc: Marks the mode as global/filter/hidden and starts TrackIR if available.

update.desc: Reads TrackIR.getData and applies translation and rotation to data.res.

returns.desc: true; nil if TrackIR is not active
